description: Save people from the review queue as leads (in a list named after their search), and optionally add them to a sequence. Pass ids from one search, or a searchId to approve everyone still waiting in it. If the sequence is running, the first call returns what will be sent and needs confirm: true. Without LinkedIn connected the leads wait inside the sequence until it is started.

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user agreed to what the first call (without it) said would happen.

ids.description: Result ids from list_search_results, all from the same search

searchId.description: Approve everyone still to review in this search

sequenceId.description: Also add them to this sequence (see list_sequences)

name: approve_leads
title: Approve search results
